feature: Video compile title-card failure visibility and Beads/OpenSpec repository setup

assertions.expected: A failed requested title card names its scene in a visible warning for human and agent callers, even when concat succeeds.
assertions.observed: The controlled ffmpeg stub failed only the title-card invocation; tests observed the scene-specific warning, successful concat, and final compile state.

assertions.expected: Successful title cards render once at each scene boundary; shots within one scene share one card; explicit no-title-cards renders no cards or warning.
assertions.observed: All baseline cases are asserted by the focused test.

assertions.expected: Cross-era migration preserves the authoritative legacy Dolt issue records and associated data.
assertions.observed: All 574 issue IDs and checked issue fields, labels, dependencies, and comment payloads matched the normalized legacy export exactly.

warnings_and_limits: The first targeted Vitest attempt failed before test discovery because the default sandbox returned spawn EPERM; the identical command passed with process-execution escalation.
bd doctor --check validate is unsupported in embedded mode; the supported artifacts, conventions, and pollution checks exited successfully.
Vitest emitted Node loader and Vite config-loader deprecation warnings; tests passed.
The tracked legacy JSONL has 85 unique IDs absent from the authoritative Dolt database. It remains unchanged; a follow-up issue tracks review before any import.
